text: Solomiya Krushelnytska saves Giacomo Puccini's opera "Madama Butterfly" by triumphantly performing the role of Cio-Cio-San at the Teatro Grande in Brescia
Mykola Sadovskyi founds the first permanent professional Ukrainian theater in Kyiv
The first volume of the "Dictionary of the Ukrainian Language," edited by Borys Hrinchenko, is published
Igor Sikorsky makes his first successful flight on his own aircraft in Kyiv
Founding of the "Plast" scouting organization in Lviv
Lesya Ukrainka writes the dramatic fantasy "The Forest Song"
Grand opening of the Kyiv Conservatory
Kyiv aircraft designer Igor Sikorsky creates the world's first four-engine airplane, the "Russky Vityaz"
First performance of Mykola Leontovych's "Shchedryk" by the Kyiv University choir
Formation of the Ukrainian Central Rada in Kyiv
Founding of the Ukrainian Academy of Arts in Kyiv
Founding of the Ukrainian Academy of Sciences
Hetman Pavlo Skoropadskyi founds the Kamianets-Podilskyi State Ukrainian University
Signing of the Act of Unification of the UNR and the ZUNR
Oleksandr Koshyts' choir performs "Shchedryk" abroad for the first time, in Prague
The Odesa Film Factory (now Odesa Film Studio) is founded, one of the world's first film factories
The Ukrainian Free University is founded in Vienna
"Shchedryk" is performed for the first time at Carnegie Hall in New York
Founding of the literary group VAPLITE
Les Kurbas's "Berezil" theater moves to Kharkiv
Premiere of Oleksandr Dovzhenko's film "Zvenyhora"
Grand opening of the Derzhprom building in Kharkiv
Premiere of Oleksandr Dovzhenko's film "Arsenal"
Premiere of Oleksandr Dovzhenko's film "Earth"
For the first time in the USSR, the splitting of a lithium atomic nucleus is achieved at the Ukrainian Institute of Physics and Technology
Launch of the Dnieper Hydroelectric Station (Dniprohes)
The capital of the Ukrainian SSR is moved from Kharkiv to Kyiv
American composer of Ukrainian descent Peter Wilhousky creates the English-language version of "Shchedryk" — "Carol of the Bells"
Ukraine becomes one of the founding countries of the United Nations
In Feofaniya near Kyiv, the creation of MESM — the first electronic computing machine in continental Europe — is completed
Opening of the Paton Bridge in Kyiv, the world's first all-welded bridge
Crimean oblast is transferred to the Ukrainian SSR
Serhii Korolov, a native of Zhytomyr region, leads the launch of the world's first artificial satellite
Opening of the first line of the Kyiv Metro
Founding of the Institute of Cybernetics of the Academy of Sciences of the Ukrainian SSR in Kyiv
Premiere of Sergei Parajanov's film "Shadows of Forgotten Ancestors" at the Ukraina cinema in Kyiv
Gymnast Lyudmila Turishcheva wins Olympic gold in the individual all-around at the Munich Games
Dynamo Kyiv, coached by Valeriy Lobanovskyi, wins the UEFA Cup Winners' Cup
Lina Kostenko's historical novel in verse "Marusia Churai" is published
Kyiv hosts football matches of the XXII Summer Olympic Games
Serhii Bubka wins Olympic gold in pole vault at the Seoul Games
The 1000th anniversary of the Baptism of Kyivan Rus is solemnly celebrated in Ukraine
The Ukrainian language is granted state language status in the Ukrainian SSR
The People's Movement of Ukraine (Rukh) is founded
The Declaration of State Sovereignty of Ukraine is adopted
The Act of Declaration of Independence of Ukraine is adopted
The all-Ukrainian referendum confirms the state's independence
The Ukrainian karbovanets is introduced into circulation
Figure skater Viktor Petrenko wins Olympic gold at the Albertville Games
The Budapest Memorandum on security assurances for Ukraine is signed
Serhii Bubka sets a world record in pole vault (6.14 m)
Oksana Baiul wins independent Ukraine's first Olympic gold in figure skating at the Lillehammer Games
Launch of the first Ukrainian satellite, "Sich-1"
The Constitution of Ukraine is adopted
The national currency, the hryvnia, is introduced into circulation
Gymnast Lilia Podkopayeva wins Olympic gold in the individual all-around at the Atlanta Games
Volodymyr Klitschko wins Olympic gold in super heavyweight boxing at the Atlanta Games
At age 14, Ruslan Ponomariov becomes the youngest grandmaster in the world
Vitali Klitschko wins his first world boxing championship title under the WBO
Volodymyr Klitschko wins the WBO world boxing championship title
Swimmer Yana Klochkova wins two Olympic golds in individual medley swimming at the Sydney Games
Opening of the Independence Monument on Maidan Nezalezhnosti in Kyiv
Ruslan Ponomariov becomes the youngest FIDE world chess champion
Ruslana wins the Eurovision Song Contest with "Wild Dances"
Ukraine's national team wins gold at the World Chess Olympiad in Calvià
Vitali Klitschko wins the WBC world boxing championship title
The Eurovision Song Contest is held in Kyiv for the first time
Ukraine's national football team reaches the World Cup quarterfinals for the first time in its history
Verka Serduchka takes second place at Eurovision with the song "Dancing Lasha Tumbai"
Volodymyr Klitschko unifies the WBO, IBF, and IBO titles, becoming the undisputed heavyweight world champion
Launch of the second Ukrainian satellite, "Sich-2"
Ukraine, together with Poland, hosts the final match of the UEFA European Football Championship in Kyiv
Premiere of Myroslav Slaboshpytskyi's film "The Tribe" at the Cannes Film Festival
